label: Standard
blurb: The Genus default. Flat surfaces, clear borders, compact rows.
$note: The identity Look and the permanent escape hatch. Its patch is EMPTY on purpose — Standard is not a set of values, it is the absence of a Look, so `merge({}, overrides)` resolves to exactly what the build emits today. That is what makes 'go back to Standard' free and unbreakable: there is nothing to get wrong. It is also the only Look allowed a non-zero defect count, because those 125 are the product's existing known defects and not something a Look introduced.
